adaptations: Catalog building has one video track, default names and Opus defaults, validation, and avcC-derived H.264 codec strings. It emits UTF-8 bytes.
Source composition accepts explicit https/moqt URLs and namespace tuples, with RFC 3986 token escaping.

The internal catalog parser retains the independent-catalog path for builder round-trip tests; player presentation types, variable substitution, and delta updates are omitted. It is not a public reader API.
H.264 Annex B helpers and LOC properties are ported from the Relay Python example, with validation shared through spec vectors.
migration: Attributed extraction for reuse by Video.js. Changes to format behavior should migrate upstream.
